analysis_role: Post-result single-taxon falsification of the fixed transition-regime H1. Determine whether its direction or exact exceptional rank requires any one taxon in the strict n>=10 East-Asian panel.

tests.deletion_panels: Delete each of the nine strict-panel taxa once; restandardize BIO15/BIO1 within the remaining eight taxa; use the same CTMC/Brownian estimator and enumerate every count-preserving state map.
tests.primary_direction_rule: For every deletion panel, observed composite must remain positive on all six accepted topologies.
tests.secondary_exceptionality_rule: For each deletion panel, report whether the exact one-sided finite-map rank remains <=0.05.

decision_rule.class1: all nine deletion panels retain positive composite on all six topologies AND all nine exact ranks <=0.05
decision_rule.class2: all nine deletion panels retain positive composite on all six topologies BUT at least one exact rank >0.05
decision_rule.class3: at least one deletion panel has a non-positive composite on at least one topology

claim_ceiling: A single-deletion result is a sensitivity analysis, not independent replication.
Failure of exact <=0.05 after deletion may reflect reduced finite-map resolution as well as biological dependence and must be reported with the actual rank.
Do not alter the vector, taxa states, or environmental variables after inspection.
No result establishes climatic causation, selection, adaptation, or a mediator.
